title: Watersound "30-A-OK" 265 Salt Box Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Less than 5-minute walk to the beach- Flat-screen TVs in all bedrooms- Nespresso machine- 4-passenger golf cart- 4 adult bikes- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Free WiFi- Highchair- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout*This property comes with 2 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: It's all good at 30A-OK! With a 4-passenger golf cart, modern interiors, and an office space, there is something for every type of visitor to appreciate. There are 3 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms in the home, with an additional bonus loft on the third floor. Enter through the white picket fence into a chic, cozy living room and an updated kitchen with premium, stainless steel appliances and quartz countertops. There is seating for 11 guests at the breakfast bar and dining table. Down the hall, you'll see an office nook complete with built-in shelves and a desk to make working remote a breeze. There are also 2 corresponding guest bedrooms on this floor with a king and a queen bed and private bathrooms.On the second floor, there is a primary suite with a queen bed and full over full bunk bed with twin trundle and a private bathroom attached that includes a walk-in shower and clawfoot bathtub. There is an additional bonus loft on the third floor with a twin daybed and twin trundle underneath.Guests will love using the golf cart or bikes to cruise around the gated neighborhood of WaterSound and around 30A to the nearby communities of Rosemary and Seaside! You're also just a short walk away from beautiful Gulf waters and the community pool. Don't miss your chance to stay at 30A-OK!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom - Queen Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Guest Bedroom - King Bed, Private Bathroom With Walk In ShowerSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom - Queen Bed and Full over Full Bunk bed with Twin Trundle, Private Bathroom With Shower and Tub SeparateTHIRD FLOOR:- Bonus Loft - Twin Day Bed With Twin Trundle Underneath*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.

This home permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate. DETAILS: It's all good at 30A-OK! With a 4-passenger golf cart, modern interiors, and an office space, there is something for every type of visitor to appreciate. There are 3 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms in the home, with an additional bonus loft on the third floor. Enter through the white picket fence into a chic, cozy living room and an updated kitchen with premium, stainless steel appliances and quartz countertops. There is seating for 11 guests at the breakfast bar and dining table. Down the hall, you'll see an office nook complete with built-in shelves and a desk to make working remote a breeze. There are also 2 corresponding guest bedrooms on this floor with a king and a queen bed and private bathrooms. On the second floor, there is a primary suite with a queen bed and full over full bunk bed with twin trundle and a private bathroom attached that includes a walk-in shower and clawfoot bathtub. There is an additional bonus loft on the third floor with a twin daybed and twin trundle underneath. Guests will love using the golf cart or bikes to cruise around the gated neighborhood of WaterSound and around 30A to the nearby communities of Rosemary and Seaside! You're also just a short walk away from beautiful Gulf waters and the community pool. Don't miss your chance to stay at 30A-OK!
